integrity: The derivation is self-contained except for standard Perron–Frobenius/Parry principles. A finite exact-integer checker supplements but does not replace the all-parameter proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to the binary union of two complementary single-run avoidance shifts; the rationality of sofic minimal-forbidden-word series and the Parry theorem for irreducible shifts of finite type are established background. No claim about equality of generating-forbidden and minimal-forbidden entropies. Historical priority beyond inspected records is uncertain.
title: A run-forbidden union with an exact minimal-forbidden series and two entropy-maximizing phases
